headline: Recommends merging Harbor and Shellfish commissions and folding Project Canopy into Sustainability Commission.
summary: Members recommended folding the Project Canopy work into the Sustainability Commission and merging the Harbor and Shellfish commissions. They approved combining zoning appeals and assessment review membership and sent several code and council rule changes forward.
decisions: Recommended dissolving the Project Canopy Committee and moving its tree work into the Sustainability Commission, unanimous.
Recommended correcting the Canon Plaza park listing in the code to cover both lots and fix the section numbers.
Approved combining Zoning Board of Appeals and Board of Assessment Review membership, unanimous.
Approved reducing the Shellfish Conservation Committee to five members, unanimous.
Recommended combining the Harbor Commission and shellfish commission, unanimous, as amended.
Recommended changes to the City Council's rules, sent to the next council meeting.
Recommended moving standing committees into Code Division 19, with school employees excluded from personnel committee review.
discussion: Shellfish panel size: Members debated whether to set the group at five or seven members, and whether state law requires a set number. The group was reduced to five.

Council rules and orders: Members discussed whether council rules need an ordinance and whether changes need two-thirds approval or a majority vote. One view was that rules should take effect right away.
Personnel committee size: Members asked whether the group should have an odd number of members, and a past reason for keeping it at four was repeated.
Canon Plaza park listing: Staff said the code lists the wrong lots and section numbers and that other park entries need updating.
